title: Returns Centre Service Standards
content:
The Marlowe & Finch returns centre works Returns & Exchanges parcels to the following service standards, counted in business days.

| Return type | Receipt to posted inspection | Inspection to settlement | No carrier movement before a parcel on a Marlowe & Finch label is traced |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | 5 business days | 2 business days | 10 business days |
| Store Credit Return | 5 business days | 2 business days | 10 business days |
| Size Exchange | 5 business days | 2 business days | 10 business days |
| Instant Exchange | 5 business days | 2 business days | 10 business days |
| Gift Return | 5 business days | 2 business days | 10 business days |
| Quality Issue Return | 7 business days | 2 business days | 10 business days |

- The Quality Issue Return is allowed 7 business days from receipt to posted inspection; every other type 5.
- Settlement follows inspection within 2 business days on every type.
- The trace standard applies to a parcel travelling on a Marlowe & Finch label or QR code that shows no carrier movement for 10 business days after its last scan.
